notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Engine overhaul, the game should be more stable and more performant.
[*]Changed the penalty for a bad glyph: instead of completely resetting the chain, apply -5 to it, making the mechanic less punitive for long chains.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] After 0.5second of overtime, the next glyph glow to help you
[*] Freeze bonus reworked, now can be stack if picked up multiple time
[*] Updated steamwork lib to 1.58a, and opening overlay now pause the game
[*] Help link is now translated
[*] Added option menu where language and music/effect can be changed
[*] Reworked hitbox of UI element.
[*] Reworked end clock sound mechanism.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
* changed UI to improve first time understanding and visibility
* reduced slightly hitbox of UI
* fixed divers internal problem

- fixed crash when configuration for "presentmode" is not correct
- fixed freeze when some sound start playing
- fixed incorrect vulkan dependency and some GPU particularity
